renderDashboard starts loadUser and loadSettings together through all.
pageData is a single future that resolves after both branch results are collected.

explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.fork: loadPage spawns loadHeader and loadSidebar as parallel processes.

explorer.examples.fork-join.title: Fork Join
explorer.examples.future-settlement.guid: receiveSmsCode settles smsCode with the received code.
verifyPhoneNumber waits on smsCode until another process settles it.
explorer.examples.race-winner.guide.race: loadProfile starts readCache and fetchNetwork as competing branches.
explorer.examples.race-winner.guide.winn: firstProfile resolves from the first completed branch while the race arena closes the remaining work.
explorer.examples.race-winner.title: Race Winner
publishArticle runs commitArticle inside enclose and later returns its result.
enclose creates a child scope that owns work spawned inside the boundary.
commitArticle produces published before updateSearchIndex finishes, but enclose waits for owned work before returning.

explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.par: submitOrder returns order accepted without waiting for sendReceiptEmail.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.spa: submitOrder starts sendReceiptEmail as a spawned process.
